verdict.rationale: Tuning index parameters is a fair question for a vector database, but the evidence pack never documents user-tunable HNSW settings, selectable index types, or any recall/latency/memory trade-off controls. A community remark that Pinecone had HNSW says nothing about tuning it, and the backup docs' mention of 'experiment with configurations' is an adjacent feature, not parameter tuning.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can tune index parameters (HNSW graph settings, index types) to trade recall against latency and memory
